class.name: LocalLoopbackSession
class.brief_description: Connects [LocalMultiplayerPeer] peers inside one process, with optional simulated latency and loss.

method.name: advance_time
method.description: Moves time forward by [param ms] milliseconds and delivers the packets that are due.

method.name: clear_all_link_conditions
method.description: Removes every link condition and delivers every delayed packet.

method.name: clear_link_conditions
method.description: Removes the link conditions for [param sender_id] and delivers the packets they delayed.

method.name: create_client_peer
method.description: Creates a client peer, links it to the server in both directions, and returns it.

method.name: get_client_peer
method.description: Creates a client peer and returns it.

method.name: get_client_peers
method.description: Returns every client peer created, including closed ones.

method.name: get_link_conditions
method.description: Returns the conditions installed on [param peer] for [param sender_id], or [code]null[/code] if there are none.

method.name: get_server_peer
method.description: Returns the server peer, creating it first if necessary.

method.name: get_shared_session
method.description: Returns the shared session, creating it if needed. [method has_shared_session] checks without creating it.

method.name: has_live_server
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the server peer exists and is connected.

method.name: has_shared_session
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when a shared session exists.

method.name: hold_inbound_packets
method.description: Holds every packet bound for [param peer], including ones already queued, until [method release_inbound_packets].

method.name: in_flight_count
method.description: Returns how many packets are still in flight to [param peer].

method.name: init_server_side
method.description: Creates the server peer if there is not already a live one.

method.name: is_holding_inbound
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while [method hold_inbound_packets] holds packets for [param peer].

method.name: poll
method.description: Moves time forward by one physics tick and delivers the packets that are due.

method.name: poll_frame_scoped
method.description: Moves time forward by the physics frames that passed since the last call.

method.name: purge_packets_from
method.description: Drops every packet from [param sender_id] not delivered yet.

method.name: release_inbound_packets
method.description: Delivers the packets [method hold_inbound_packets] held, in order.

method.name: reset
method.description: Closes every peer and empties the session so a new server can host.

method.name: set_link_conditions
method.description: Applies [param conditions] to packets arriving at [param peer] from [param sender_id], or from everyone when [code]0[/code]. [param conditions] is copied.

method.name: set_shared_session
method.description: Sets the shared session. [code]null[/code] clears it.
